name: Short-crowding into prior weakness: deep-negative funding + downtrend reversal (NOT reversal-alone)
rationale: Thesis: generic 'buy recent weakness' mean-reversion is over-mined. The edge is buying weakness ONLY when the prior sell-off has crowded shorts to a positioning extreme — the overhang that fuels a squeeze. Entry (long-only spot): funding_rate < deeply-negative floor [-0.005,-0.0005] (crowded shorts) AND ret_Nd over a medium lookback < a NEGATIVE ceiling (i.e. the asset is recently DOWN, the reversal setup). DISCONFIRMER: must beat ret_Nd<negative-ceiling ALONE with the SAME lookback and ceiling and no funding gate — if lone recent-weakness matches net Sharpe, the funding gate is worthless and this is plain reversion. The funding positioning gate is the claim. funding_feature null — level, not carry. Exit on a profit target / time / funding normalizing up.
catalyst: recent multi-day weakness coinciding with deeply-negative (crowded-short) funding
